verses.en: Lo, mine eye hath seen all this, mine ear hath heard and understood it.
verses.pt: Eis que os meus olhos viram tudo isto, e os meus ouvidos o ouviram e entenderam.
verses.en_web: “Behold, my eye has seen all this. My ear has heard and understood it.
verses.en_bbe: Truly, my eye has seen all this, word of it has come to my ear, and I have knowledge of it.

verses.en: What ye know, the same do I know also: I am not inferior unto you.
verses.pt: O que vós sabeis também eu o sei; não vos sou inferior.
verses.en_web: What you know, I know also. I am not inferior to you.
verses.en_bbe: The same things are in my mind as in yours; I am equal to you.

verses.en: Surely I would speak to the Almighty, and I desire to reason with God.
verses.pt: Mas eu falarei ao Todo-Poderoso, e quero defender-me perante Deus.
verses.en_web: “Surely I would speak to the Almighty. I desire to reason with God.
verses.en_bbe: But I would have talk with the Ruler of all, and my desire is to have an argument with God.

verses.en: But ye are forgers of lies, ye are all physicians of no value.
verses.pt: Vós, porém, sois forjadores de mentiras, e vós todos, médicos que não valem nada.
verses.en_web: But you are forgers of lies. You are all physicians of no value.
verses.en_bbe: But you put a false face on things; all your attempts to put things right are of no value.

verses.en: Oh that ye would altogether hold your peace! and it should be your wisdom.
verses.pt: Oxalá vos calásseis de todo, pois assim passaríeis por sábios.
verses.en_web: Oh that you would be completely silent! Then you would be wise.
verses.en_bbe: If only you would keep quiet, it would be a sign of wisdom!

verses.en: Hear now my reasoning, and hearken to the pleadings of my lips.
verses.pt: Ouvi agora a minha defesa, e escutai os argumentos dos meus lábios.
verses.en_web: Hear now my reasoning. Listen to the pleadings of my lips.
verses.en_bbe: Give ear to the argument of my mouth, and take note of the words of my lips.

verses.en: Will ye speak wickedly for God? and talk deceitfully for him?
verses.pt: Falareis falsamente por Deus, e por ele proferireis mentiras?
verses.en_web: Will you speak unrighteously for God, and talk deceitfully for him?
verses.en_bbe: Will you say in God's name what is not right, and put false words into his mouth?

verses.en: Will ye accept his person? will ye contend for God?
verses.pt: Fareis aceitação da sua pessoa? Contendereis a favor de Deus?
verses.en_web: Will you show partiality to him? Will you contend for God?
verses.en_bbe: Will you have respect for God's person in this cause, and put yourselves forward as his supporters?

verses.en: Is it good that he should search you out? or as one man mocketh another, do ye so mock him?
verses.pt: Ser-vos-ia bom, se ele vos esquadrinhasse? Ou zombareis dele, como quem zomba de um homem?
verses.en_web: Is it good that he should search you out? Or as one deceives a man, will you deceive him?
verses.en_bbe: Will it be good for you to be searched out by him, or have you the thought that he may be guided into error like a man?

verses.en: He will surely reprove you, if ye do secretly accept persons.
verses.pt: Certamente vos repreenderá, se em oculto vos deixardes levar de respeitos humanos.
verses.en_web: He will surely reprove you, if you secretly show partiality.
verses.en_bbe: He will certainly put you right, if you have respect for persons in secret.

verses.en: Shall not his excellency make you afraid? and his dread fall upon you?
verses.pt: Não vos amedrontará a sua majestade? E não cairá sobre vós o seu terror?
verses.en_web: Shall not his majesty make you afraid, And his dread fall on you?
verses.en_bbe: Will not his glory put you in fear, so that your hearts will be overcome before him?

verses.en: Your remembrances are like unto ashes, your bodies to bodies of clay.
verses.pt: As vossas máximas são provérbios de cinza; as vossas defesas são torres de barro.
verses.en_web: Your memorable sayings are proverbs of ashes, Your defenses are defenses of clay.
verses.en_bbe: Your wise sayings are only dust, and your strong places are only earth.

verses.en: Hold your peace, let me alone, that I may speak, and let come on me what will.
verses.pt: Calai-vos perante mim, para que eu fale, e venha sobre mim o que vier.
verses.en_web: “Be silent, leave me alone, that I may speak. Let come on me what will.
verses.en_bbe: Keep quiet, and let me say what is in my mind, whatever may come to me.

verses.en: Wherefore do I take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in mine hand?
verses.pt: Tomarei a minha carne entre os meus dentes, e porei a minha vida na minha mão.
verses.en_web: Why should I take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in my hand?
verses.en_bbe: I will take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in my hand.

verses.en: Though he slay me, yet will I trust in him: but I will maintain mine own ways before him.
verses.pt: Eis que ele me matará; não tenho esperança; contudo defenderei os meus caminhos diante dele.
verses.en_web: Behold, he will kill me. I have no hope. Nevertheless, I will maintain my ways before him.
verses.en_bbe: Truly, he will put an end to me; I have no hope; but I will not give way in argument before him;

verses.en: He also shall be my salvation: for an hypocrite shall not come before him.
verses.pt: Também isso será a minha salvação, pois o ímpio não virá perante ele.
verses.en_web: This also shall be my salvation, that a godless man shall not come before him.
verses.en_bbe: And that will be my salvation, for an evil-doer would not come before him,

verses.en: Hear diligently my speech, and my declaration with your ears.
verses.pt: Ouvi atentamente as minhas palavras, e chegue aos vossos ouvidos a minha declaração.
verses.en_web: Hear diligently my speech. Let my declaration be in your ears.
verses.en_bbe: Give ear with care to my words, and keep what I say in your minds.

verses.en: Behold now, I have ordered my cause; I know that I shall be justified.
verses.pt: Eis que já pus em ordem a minha causa, e sei que serei achado justo:
verses.en_web: See now, I have set my cause in order. I know that I am righteous.
verses.en_bbe: See now, I have put my cause in order, and I am certain that I will be seen to be right.

verses.en: Who is he that will plead with me? for now, if I hold my tongue, I shall give up the ghost.
verses.pt: Quem é o que contenderá comigo? Pois então me calaria e renderia o espírito.
verses.en_web: Who is he who will contend with me? For then would I hold my peace and give up the spirit.
verses.en_bbe: Is any one able to take up the argument against me? If so, I would keep quiet and give up my breath.

verses.en: Only do not two things unto me: then will I not hide myself from thee.
verses.pt: Concede-me somente duas coisas; então não me esconderei do teu rosto:
verses.en_web: “Only don’t do two things to me; then I will not hide myself from your face:
verses.en_bbe: Only two things do not do to me, then I will come before your face:

verses.en: Withdraw thine hand far from me: and let not thy dread make me afraid.
verses.pt: desvia a tua mão rara longe de mim, e não me amedronte o teu terror.
verses.en_web: withdraw your hand far from me; and don’t let your terror make me afraid.
verses.en_bbe: Take your hand far away from me; and let me not be overcome by fear of you.

verses.en: Then call thou, and I will answer: or let me speak, and answer thou me.
verses.pt: Então chama tu, e eu responderei; ou eu falarei, e me responde tu.
verses.en_web: Then call, and I will answer; or let me speak, and you answer me.
verses.en_bbe: Then at the sound of your voice I will give answer; or let me put forward my cause for you to give me an answer.

verses.en: How many are mine iniquities and sins? make me to know my transgression and my sin.
verses.pt: Quantas iniqüidades e pecados tenho eu? Faze-me saber a minha transgressão e o meu pecado.
verses.en_web: How many are my iniquities and sins? Make me know my disobedience and my sin.
verses.en_bbe: What is the number of my evil-doings and my sins? give me knowledge of them.

verses.en: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, and holdest me for thine enemy?
verses.pt: Por que escondes o teu rosto, e me tens por teu inimigo?
verses.en_web: Why hide you your face, and hold me for your enemy?
verses.en_bbe: Why is your face veiled from me, as if I was numbered among your haters?

verses.en: Wilt thou break a leaf driven to and fro? and wilt thou pursue the dry stubble?
verses.pt: Acossarás uma folha arrebatada pelo vento? E perseguirás o restolho seco?
verses.en_web: Will you harass a driven leaf? Will you pursue the dry stubble?
verses.en_bbe: Will you be hard on a leaf in flight before the wind? will you make a dry stem go more quickly on its way?

verses.en: For thou writest bitter things against me, and makest me to possess the iniquities of my youth.
verses.pt: Pois escreves contra mim coisas amargas, e me fazes herdar os erros da minha mocidade;
verses.en_web: For you write bitter things against me, and make me inherit the iniquities of my youth:
verses.en_bbe: For you put bitter things on record against me, and send punishment on me for the sins of my early years;

verses.en: Thou puttest my feet also in the stocks, and lookest narrowly unto all my paths; thou settest a print upon the heels of my feet.
verses.pt: também pões no tronco os meus pés, e observas todos os meus caminhos, e marcas um termo ao redor dos meus pés,
verses.en_web: You also put my feet in the stocks, and mark all my paths. You set a bound to the soles of my feet,
verses.en_bbe: And you put chains on my feet, watching all my ways, and making a limit for my steps;

verses.en: And he, as a rotten thing, consumeth, as a garment that is moth eaten.
verses.pt: apesar de eu ser como uma coisa podre que se consome, e como um vestido, ao qual rói a traça.
verses.en_web: though I am decaying like a rotten thing, like a garment that is moth-eaten.
verses.en_bbe: Though a man comes to nothing like a bit of dead wood, or like a robe which has become food for the worm.
